by
  intros f s
  have hf : (↑f).Finite := by apply_instance
  have hs : (↑s).Finite := by apply_instance
  let fs := ↑f
  let ss := ↑s
  let img := λ g, g '' ss
  have himg : ∀ g ∈ fs, (img g).Finite :=
    by { intro g, intro hg, exact Finite.Set.finite_image ss g hs }
  let union_img := ⋃ g ∈ fs, img g
  have hunion : (↑(f.seq s)).Finite :=
    Set.Finite.union_of_finite_images hf himg
  exact hunion
